title: SmolLM2-135M (q4): Chrome process RSS peak per process kind, three repetitions per path (Sprint 2)

commit.note: No commit hash was recorded. The runs were made on the Sprint 2 working tree on top of c2b6166; that tree was committed the same evening (2987235 to 20c198f).

method: An independent harness (the lane report calls it T1's runtime-legs.mjs; it is a workspace script and is not committed here) launches Chrome, answers the same prompt once per path (WebGPU, forced WebAssembly) and samples the processes of the browser while the leg runs. peakRssKiB is the peak per process kind (renderer, gpu, browser, other) in KiB; the renderer figure includes WebAssembly memory and is a coarse proxy, not a GPU-memory figure. peakJsHeapUsedSize is CDP JSHeapUsedSize. Three repetitions per path; the README range covers all of them.
commands: node runtime-legs.mjs webgpu wasm  (the lane harness, not in this repository)
RUNTIME_MODEL=1 RUNTIME_MODEL_LEGS=wasm npm run test:model  (the in-repository run; test/browser/rss.ts samples the same way for the unload test)
